   949	struct RecommendationCampaignOutcomePolicyBuilder
   950	{
   951	    static RecommendationCampaignOutcomePolicy Build(
   952	        const RecommendationCampaignOutcomePolicyInput& input)
   953	    {
   954	        if (input.contractVersion !=
   955	            kRecommendationCampaignOutcomePolicyContractVersion)
   956	            throw std::invalid_argument(
   957	                "recommendation_campaign_outcome_policy_version_unsupported");
   958	        if (input.minimumComparableMemberCount <= 0 ||
   959	            input.minimumComparableMemberCount >
   960	                kMaximumRecommendationCampaignOutcomeAssessmentMembers)
   961	            throw std::invalid_argument(
   962	                "recommendation_campaign_outcome_policy_minimum_evidence_invalid");
   963	        auto rules = CanonicalRules(input.requiredMetricRules);
   964	        std::string canonical = PolicyCanonicalText(
   965	            input.minimumComparableMemberCount, rules);
   966	        RecommendationCampaignOutcomePolicyIdentity identity(
   967	            kRecommendationCampaignOutcomePolicyContractVersion,
   968	            canonical, RecommendationCanonicalHash(canonical));
   969	        return RecommendationCampaignOutcomePolicy(
   970	            input.minimumComparableMemberCount, std::move(rules),
   971	            std::move(identity));
   972	    }
   973	};
   974	
   975	struct RecommendationCampaignOutcomePolicyDecisionBuilder
   976	{
   977	    static RecommendationCampaignOutcomePolicyDecision Build(
   978	        const RecommendationCampaignOutcomePolicy& policy,
   979	        const Assessment& assessment)
   980	    {
   981	        ValidateAssessment(policy, assessment);
   982	
   983	        std::vector<PolicyMember> members;
   984	        members.reserve(assessment.members.size());
   985	        std::vector<PolicyReason> evidenceReasons;
   986	        std::vector<PolicyReason> interpretationReasons;
   987	        bool requiredMetricMissing = false;
   988	        bool requiredMetricNotComparable = false;
   989	
   990	        for (const auto& assessed : assessment.members)
   991	        {
   992	            const auto classification =
   993	                EvidenceClassificationFrom(assessed.outcome);
   994	            AddMemberReason(interpretationReasons, classification);
   995	            switch (classification)
   996	            {
   997	                case EvidenceClassification::Inconsistent:
   998	                case EvidenceClassification::NotReady:
   999	                case EvidenceClassification::TerminalCancelled:
  1000	                case EvidenceClassification::SucceededContextChanged:
  1001	                case EvidenceClassification::SucceededMetricGap:
  1002	                    AddMemberReason(evidenceReasons, classification);
  1003	                    break;
  1004	                case EvidenceClassification::TerminalFailed:
  1005	                case EvidenceClassification::SucceededComparable:
  1006	                    break;
  1007	            }
  1008	            for (const auto& comparison : assessed.comparisons)
  1009	            {
  1010	                AddComparisonReason(
  1011	                    interpretationReasons, comparison.classification);
  1012	                AddComparisonReason(evidenceReasons, comparison.classification);
  1013	            }
  1014	
  1015	            std::vector<MetricEvaluation> evaluations;
  1016	            evaluations.reserve(policy.requiredMetricRules.size());
  1017	            const bool successfulEvidence =
  1018	                classification ==
  1019	                    EvidenceClassification::SucceededContextChanged ||
  1020	                classification ==
  1021	                    EvidenceClassification::SucceededMetricGap ||
  1022	                classification ==
  1023	                    EvidenceClassification::SucceededComparable;
  1024	            for (const auto& rule : policy.requiredMetricRules)
  1025	            {
  1026	                const auto* comparison =
  1027	                    FindComparison(assessed, rule.metricIdentity);
  1028	                if (!comparison)
  1029	                {
  1030	                    if (successfulEvidence) requiredMetricMissing = true;
  1031	                    evaluations.push_back(MetricEvaluation(
  1032	                        rule.metricIdentity, rule.direction, std::nullopt,
  1033	                        std::nullopt, MetricJudgment::NotEvaluable));
  1034	                    continue;
  1035	                }
  1036	                if (comparison->classification !=
  1037	                        AssessmentClassification::Comparable ||
  1038	                    !comparison->delta)
  1039	                {
  1040	                    if (successfulEvidence)
  1041	                        requiredMetricNotComparable = true;
  1042	                    evaluations.push_back(MetricEvaluation(
  1043	                        rule.metricIdentity, rule.direction,
  1044	                        comparison->classification, std::nullopt,
  1045	                        MetricJudgment::NotEvaluable));
  1046	                    continue;
  1047	                }
  1048	                evaluations.push_back(MetricEvaluation(rule.metricIdentity,
  1049	                    rule.direction, comparison->classification,
  1050	                    comparison->delta,
  1050	                    comparison->delta,
  1051	                    JudgeDelta(*comparison->delta, rule.direction)));
  1052	            }
  1053	
  1054	            MemberInterpretation interpretation =
  1055	                MemberInterpretation::Inconclusive;
  1056	            if (classification == EvidenceClassification::TerminalFailed)
  1057	                interpretation = MemberInterpretation::Unfavorable;
  1058	            else if (classification ==
  1059	                EvidenceClassification::SucceededComparable)
  1060	                interpretation = InterpretMetricJudgments(evaluations);
  1061	
  1062	            members.push_back(PolicyMember(assessed.identity, assessed.lifecycle,
  1063	                assessed.consistency, assessed.outcome,
  1064	                assessed.diagnostics, classification, interpretation,
  1065	                std::move(evaluations)));
  1066	        }
  1067	
  1068	        if (requiredMetricMissing)
  1069	        {
  1070	            AddReason(evidenceReasons, PolicyReason::RequiredMetricMissing);
  1071	            AddReason(interpretationReasons,
  1072	                PolicyReason::RequiredMetricMissing);
  1073	        }
  1074	        if (requiredMetricNotComparable)
  1075	        {
  1076	            AddReason(evidenceReasons,
  1077	                PolicyReason::RequiredMetricNotComparable);
  1078	            AddReason(interpretationReasons,
  1079	                PolicyReason::RequiredMetricNotComparable);
  1080	        }
  1081	
  1082	        MutableCounts counts;
  1083	        for (const auto& member : members) CountMember(counts, member);
  1084	        if (counts.comparable < policy.minimumComparableMemberCount)
  1085	        {
  1086	            AddReason(evidenceReasons,
  1087	                PolicyReason::MinimumComparableMembersNotMet);
  1088	            AddReason(interpretationReasons,
  1089	                PolicyReason::MinimumComparableMembersNotMet);
  1090	        }
  1091	        if (counts.favorableMetrics > 0)
  1092	            AddReason(interpretationReasons,
  1093	                PolicyReason::FavorableMetricEvidencePresent);
  1094	        if (counts.neutralMetrics > 0)
  1095	            AddReason(interpretationReasons,
  1096	                PolicyReason::NeutralMetricEvidencePresent);
  1097	        if (counts.unfavorableMetrics > 0)
  1098	            AddReason(interpretationReasons,
  1099	                PolicyReason::UnfavorableMetricEvidencePresent);
  1100	        CanonicalizeReasons(evidenceReasons);
  1101	        CanonicalizeReasons(interpretationReasons);
  1102	
  1103	        const EvidenceSufficiency sufficiency = evidenceReasons.empty()
  1104	            ? EvidenceSufficiency::Sufficient
  1105	            : EvidenceSufficiency::Insufficient;
  1106	        const CampaignInterpretation campaignInterpretation =
  1107	            DeriveCampaignInterpretation(counts,
  1108	                static_cast<int>(members.size()),
  1109	                policy.minimumComparableMemberCount, members);
  1110	        const bool eligible =
  1111	            sufficiency == EvidenceSufficiency::Sufficient &&
  1112	            counts.comparable == static_cast<int>(members.size()) &&
  1113	            campaignInterpretation == CampaignInterpretation::Favorable;
  1114	        std::vector<PolicyReason> followUpReasons;
  1115	        if (eligible)
  1116	            AddReason(followUpReasons,
  1117	                PolicyReason::AllMembersSucceededComparable);
  1118	        else
  1119	        {
  1120	            if (sufficiency == EvidenceSufficiency::Insufficient)
  1121	                AddReason(followUpReasons,
  1122	                    PolicyReason::EvidenceInsufficient);
  1123	            if (campaignInterpretation != CampaignInterpretation::Favorable)
  1124	                AddReason(followUpReasons,
  1125	                    PolicyReason::FavorableCampaignInterpretationRequired);
  1126	            for (const auto& member : members)
  1127	                AddMemberReason(
  1128	                    followUpReasons, member.evidenceClassification);
  1129	        }
  1130	        CanonicalizeReasons(followUpReasons);
  1131	
  1132	        const std::size_t metricEvaluationCount = members.size() *
  1133	            policy.requiredMetricRules.size();
  1134	        RecommendationCampaignOutcomePolicySummary summary(sufficiency,
  1135	            campaignInterpretation,
  1136	            eligible ? FollowUpEligibility::EligibleForOperatorReview
  1137	                     : FollowUpEligibility::NotEligible,
  1138	            false, static_cast<int>(members.size()), counts.inconsistent,
  1139	            counts.notReady, counts.failed, counts.cancelled,
  1140	            counts.contextChanged, counts.metricGap, counts.comparable,
  1141	            metricEvaluationCount, counts.notEvaluableMetrics,
  1142	            counts.favorableMetrics, counts.neutralMetrics,
  1143	            counts.unfavorableMetrics, std::move(evidenceReasons),
  1144	            std::move(interpretationReasons),
  1145	            std::move(followUpReasons));
  1146	        std::string canonical = DecisionCanonicalText(
  1147	            policy, assessment, summary, members);
  1148	        RecommendationCampaignOutcomePolicyDecisionIdentity identity(
  1149	            kRecommendationCampaignOutcomePolicyDecisionContractVersion,
  1150	            canonical, RecommendationCanonicalHash(canonical));
  1151	        return RecommendationCampaignOutcomePolicyDecision(
  1152	            std::move(identity), policy, assessment.identity.contractVersion,
  1153	            assessment.identity.canonicalText, assessment.identity.hash,
  1154	            assessment.campaignIdentity,
  1155	            assessment.materializationIdentity, assessment.observedAt,
  1156	            std::move(summary), std::move(members));
  1157	    }
  1158	};

   651	void ValidateRecommendationCampaignOutcomePolicyEvidence(
   652	    const RecommendationCampaignOutcomePolicyValidationView& view)
   653	{
   654	    if (view.policyContractVersion !=
   655	        kRecommendationCampaignOutcomePolicyContractVersion)
   656	        throw std::invalid_argument(
   657	            "recommendation_campaign_outcome_policy_version_unsupported");
   658	    RequireText(view.policyCanonicalText,
   659	        "recommendation_campaign_outcome_policy_identity_missing");
   660	    if (view.policyIdentityHash !=
   661	        RecommendationCanonicalHash(view.policyCanonicalText))
   662	        throw std::invalid_argument(
   663	            "recommendation_campaign_outcome_policy_identity_invalid");
   664	
   665	    if (view.assessmentContractVersion !=
   666	        kRecommendationCampaignOutcomeAssessmentContractVersion)
   667	        throw std::invalid_argument(
   668	            "recommendation_campaign_outcome_policy_assessment_version_unsupported");
   669	    RequireText(view.assessmentCanonicalText,
   670	        "recommendation_campaign_outcome_policy_assessment_identity_missing");
   671	    if (view.assessmentIdentityHash !=
   672	        RecommendationCanonicalHash(view.assessmentCanonicalText))
   673	        throw std::invalid_argument(
   674	            "recommendation_campaign_outcome_policy_assessment_identity_invalid");
   675	
   676	    RequireText(view.campaignIdentityCanonical,
   677	        "recommendation_campaign_outcome_policy_campaign_identity_missing");
   678	    if (view.campaignApprovalId <= 0 ||
   679	        view.campaignIdentityHash !=
   680	            RecommendationCanonicalHash(view.campaignIdentityCanonical))
   681	        throw std::invalid_argument(
   682	            "recommendation_campaign_outcome_policy_campaign_identity_invalid");
   683	
   684	    RequireText(view.materializationIdentityCanonical,
   685	        "recommendation_campaign_outcome_policy_materialization_identity_missing");
   686	    if (view.materializationId <= 0 ||
   687	        view.materializationCampaignApprovalId <= 0 ||
   688	        view.materializationContractVersion <= 0 ||
   689	        view.materializationIdentityHash != RecommendationCanonicalHash(
   690	            view.materializationIdentityCanonical))
   691	        throw std::invalid_argument(
   692	            "recommendation_campaign_outcome_policy_materialization_identity_invalid");
   693	    if (view.materializationCampaignApprovalId != view.campaignApprovalId ||
   694	        view.materializationCampaignIdentityHash !=
   695	            view.campaignIdentityHash)
   696	        throw std::invalid_argument(
   697	            "recommendation_campaign_outcome_policy_campaign_materialization_mismatch");
   698	
   699	    if (view.materializationMemberCount !=
   700	            static_cast<int>(view.members.size()) ||
   701	        view.assessmentSummaryMemberCount !=
   702	            static_cast<int>(view.members.size()) ||
   703	        view.members.empty() ||
   704	        view.members.size() > static_cast<std::size_t>(
   705	            kMaximumRecommendationCampaignOutcomeAssessmentMembers))
   706	        throw std::invalid_argument(
   707	            "recommendation_campaign_outcome_policy_assessment_shape_invalid");
   708	
   709	    std::set<long long> materializationMemberIds;
   710	    std::set<long long> rankingMemberIds;
   711	    std::set<long long> recommendationIds;
   712	    std::set<long long> proposalIds;
   713	    for (std::size_t index = 0; index < view.members.size(); ++index)
   714	    {
   715	        const auto& member = view.members[index];
   716	        if (member.memberOrdinal != static_cast<int>(index) + 1 ||
   717	            member.materializationMemberId <= 0 ||
   718	            member.rankingMemberId <= 0 || member.recommendationId <= 0 ||
   719	            member.sourceExperimentId <= 0 || member.proposalId <= 0 ||
   720	            (member.expectedExperimentId &&
   721	                *member.expectedExperimentId <= 0) ||
   722	            !materializationMemberIds
   723	                 .insert(member.materializationMemberId).second ||
   724	            !rankingMemberIds.insert(member.rankingMemberId).second ||
   725	            !recommendationIds.insert(member.recommendationId).second ||
   726	            !proposalIds.insert(member.proposalId).second)
   727	            throw std::invalid_argument(
   728	                "recommendation_campaign_outcome_policy_member_identity_set_invalid");
   729	        std::set<std::string> comparisonIdentities;
   730	        for (const auto& identity : member.comparisonMetricIdentities)
   731	        {
   732	            RequireText(identity,
   733	                "recommendation_campaign_outcome_policy_comparison_identity_invalid");
   734	            if (!comparisonIdentities.insert(identity).second)
   735	                throw std::invalid_argument(
   736	                    "recommendation_campaign_outcome_policy_comparison_identity_duplicate");
   737	        }
   738	    }
   739	}

   785	RecommendationCampaignOutcomePolicyMetricEvaluation::
   786	    RecommendationCampaignOutcomePolicyMetricEvaluation(
   787	        std::string metricIdentityValue,
   788	        MetricDirection directionValue,
   789	        std::optional<AssessmentClassification> evidenceClassificationValue,
   790	        std::optional<double> assessmentDeltaValue,
   791	        MetricJudgment judgmentValue)
   792	    : metricIdentity(std::move(metricIdentityValue)),
   793	      direction(directionValue),
   794	      evidenceClassification(evidenceClassificationValue),
   795	      assessmentDelta(assessmentDeltaValue && *assessmentDeltaValue == 0.0
   796	              ? std::optional<double>{0.0}
   797	              : assessmentDeltaValue),
   798	      judgment(judgmentValue)
   799	{
   800	    RequireText(metricIdentity,
   801	        "recommendation_campaign_outcome_policy_metric_evaluation_identity_invalid");
   802	    RequireValidDirection(direction);
   803	    RequireValidMetricJudgment(judgment);
   804	    if (evidenceClassification)
   805	        (void)RecommendationCampaignOutcomeAssessmentMetricComparisonClassificationText(
   806	            *evidenceClassification);
   807	    if (assessmentDelta && !std::isfinite(*assessmentDelta))
   808	        throw std::invalid_argument(
   809	            "recommendation_campaign_outcome_policy_metric_delta_nonfinite");
   810	    const bool evaluable = judgment != MetricJudgment::NotEvaluable;
   811	    if (evaluable !=
   812	            (evidenceClassification ==
   813	                    AssessmentClassification::Comparable &&
   814	                assessmentDelta.has_value()))
   815	        throw std::logic_error(
   816	            "recommendation_campaign_outcome_policy_metric_evaluation_invariant_failed");
   817	}

   819	RecommendationCampaignOutcomePolicyMember::

   826	            assessmentDiagnosticsValue,
   827	        EvidenceClassification evidenceClassificationValue,

   949	struct RecommendationCampaignOutcomePolicyBuilder
   950	{
   951	    static RecommendationCampaignOutcomePolicy Build(
   952	        const RecommendationCampaignOutcomePolicyInput& input)
   953	    {
   954	        if (input.contractVersion !=
   955	            kRecommendationCampaignOutcomePolicyContractVersion)
   956	            throw std::invalid_argument(
   957	                "recommendation_campaign_outcome_policy_version_unsupported");
   958	        if (input.minimumComparableMemberCount <= 0 ||
   959	            input.minimumComparableMemberCount >
   960	                kMaximumRecommendationCampaignOutcomeAssessmentMembers)
   961	            throw std::invalid_argument(
   962	                "recommendation_campaign_outcome_policy_minimum_evidence_invalid");
   963	        auto rules = CanonicalRules(input.requiredMetricRules);
   964	        std::string canonical = PolicyCanonicalText(
   965	            input.minimumComparableMemberCount, rules);
   966	        RecommendationCampaignOutcomePolicyIdentity identity(
   967	            kRecommendationCampaignOutcomePolicyContractVersion,
   968	            canonical, RecommendationCanonicalHash(canonical));
   969	        return RecommendationCampaignOutcomePolicy(
   970	            input.minimumComparableMemberCount, std::move(rules),
   971	            std::move(identity));
   972	    }
   973	};

   184	    bool threw = false;
   185	    try

   187	        function();

   254	            Numeric("inference_accuracy", inferenceAccuracy)};
   255	    return {Numeric("inference_accuracy", inferenceAccuracy),
   256	        Numeric("leader_score", leaderScore)};
   257	}
   258	
   259	MemberEvidence Succeeded(
   260	    int ordinal,
   261	    std::vector<Metric> sourceMetrics,
   262	    std::vector<Metric> resultMetrics,
   263	    Context sourceContext = ComparisonContext(),
   264	    Context resultContext = ComparisonContext(),
   265	    long long recommendationOffset = 0)
   266	{
   267	    return {Identity(ordinal, recommendationOffset), Lifecycle::Succeeded,
   268	        SourceEvidence{5 + ordinal, 8 + ordinal, 9 + ordinal,
   269	            std::move(sourceContext),
   270	            MetricCollection(std::move(sourceMetrics))},
   271	        ResultEvidence{7 + ordinal, 10 + ordinal,
   272	            {ResultIdentity{"r", 11 + ordinal}},
   273	            std::move(resultContext),
   274	            MetricCollection(std::move(resultMetrics))}};
   275	}
   276	
   277	MemberEvidence FavorableMember(
   278	    int ordinal,
   279	    bool reverseMetrics = false,
   280	    double favorableInferenceAccuracy = 2.0)
   281	{
   282	    return Succeeded(ordinal, SourceMetrics(1.0, 2.0, reverseMetrics),
   283	        ResultMetrics(
   284	            favorableInferenceAccuracy, 2.0, reverseMetrics));
   285	}
   286	
   287	Assessment AssessWith(
   288	    const CampaignIdentity& campaign,
   289	    const MaterializationIdentity& materialization,
   290	    std::vector<MemberEvidence> members,
   291	    std::string observedAt = "2026-07-20 00:00:00+00")
   292	{
   293	    return BuildRecommendationCampaignOutcomeAssessment(campaign,
   294	        materialization, observedAt, members);
   295	}
   296	
   297	Assessment Assess(
   298	    std::vector<MemberEvidence> members,
   299	    std::string observedAt = "2026-07-20 00:00:00+00")
   300	{
   301	    const CampaignIdentity campaign = Campaign();
   302	    const MaterializationIdentity materialization =
   303	        Materialization(campaign, static_cast<int>(members.size()));
   304	    return AssessWith(
   305	        campaign, materialization, std::move(members), std::move(observedAt));
   306	}
   307	
   308	Policy PolicyWithMinimum(int minimumComparableMemberCount)
   309	{
   310	    PolicyInput input;
   311	    input.minimumComparableMemberCount = minimumComparableMemberCount;
   312	    return BuildRecommendationCampaignOutcomePolicy(input);
   313	}
   314	
   315	Policy LowerIsFavorablePolicy()
   316	{
   317	    PolicyInput input;
   318	    input.requiredMetricRules = {
   319	        {"inference_accuracy", Direction::LowerIsFavorable},
   320	        {"leader_score", Direction::LowerIsFavorable}};
   321	    return BuildRecommendationCampaignOutcomePolicy(input);
   322	}
   323	
   324	Decision Decide(
   325	    const Assessment& assessment,
   326	    const Policy& policy = BuildRecommendationCampaignOutcomePolicy())
   327	{
   328	    return ApplyRecommendationCampaignOutcomePolicy(policy, assessment);
   329	}
   330	
   331	Proposal Propose(
   332	    const Assessment& assessment,
   333	    const Decision& decision)
   334	{
   335	    return BuildRecommendationCampaignFollowUpProposal(
   336	        assessment, decision);
   337	}
   338	
   339	void AssertRefused(
   340	    const Assessment& assessment,
   341	    const Decision& decision,
   342	    const std::string& expectedReason)
   343	{
   344	    AssertExceptionReason([&]
   345	    {
   346	        (void)Propose(assessment, decision);
   347	    }, expectedReason);
   348	}
   349	
   350	} // namespace
   351	
   352	int main()
   353	{
   354	    const Assessment favorableAssessment = Assess({FavorableMember(1)});
   355	    const Decision favorableDecision = Decide(favorableAssessment);
   356	    const Proposal favorable = Propose(
   357	        favorableAssessment, favorableDecision);
   358	
   359	    // Eligible favorable input produces one immutable advisory candidate and
   360	    // copies exact upstream identities without approval or execution power.
   361	    assert(favorable.identity.contractVersion ==
   362	        kRecommendationCampaignFollowUpProposalContractVersion);
   363	    assert(favorable.assessmentContractVersion ==
   364	        favorableAssessment.identity.contractVersion);
   365	    assert(favorable.assessmentCanonicalText ==
   366	        favorableAssessment.identity.canonicalText);
   367	    assert(favorable.assessmentIdentityHash ==
   368	        favorableAssessment.identity.hash);
   369	    assert(favorable.policyContractVersion ==
   370	        favorableDecision.policy.identity.contractVersion);
   371	    assert(favorable.policyCanonicalText ==
   372	        favorableDecision.policy.identity.canonicalText);
   373	    assert(favorable.policyIdentityHash ==
   374	        favorableDecision.policy.identity.hash);
   375	    assert(favorable.policyDecisionContractVersion ==
   376	        favorableDecision.identity.contractVersion);
   377	    assert(favorable.policyDecisionCanonicalText ==
   378	        favorableDecision.identity.canonicalText);
   379	    assert(favorable.policyDecisionIdentityHash ==
   380	        favorableDecision.identity.hash);
   381	    assert(favorable.campaignIdentity ==
   382	        favorableAssessment.campaignIdentity);
   383	    assert(favorable.materializationIdentity ==
   384	        favorableAssessment.materializationIdentity);
   385	    assert(favorable.memberCount == 1);
   386	    assert(favorable.members.size() == 1);
   387	    assert(favorable.members.front().identity ==
   388	        favorableAssessment.members.front().identity);
   389	    assert(favorable.summary.evidenceSufficiency ==
   390	        favorableDecision.summary.evidenceSufficiency);
   391	    assert(favorable.summary.campaignInterpretation ==
   392	        CampaignInterpretation::Favorable);
   393	    assert(favorable.summary.followUpEligibility ==
   394	        FollowUpEligibility::EligibleForOperatorReview);
   395	    assert(!favorable.summary.followUpAuthorized);
   396	    assert(favorable.summary.reasons ==
   397	        std::vector<ProposalReason>{
   398	            ProposalReason::EligibleFavorablePolicyDecision});
   399	
   400	    // Runtime proof mirrors every compile-time non-authority semantic.
   401	    assert(favorable.readOnly);
   402	    assert(favorable.databaseFree);
   403	    assert(!favorable.persistent);
   404	    assert(favorable.advisory);
   405	    assert(!favorable.authoritative);
   406	    assert(!favorable.approved);
   407	    assert(!favorable.activated);
   408	    assert(!favorable.executionAuthorized);
   409	    assert(!favorable.followUpAuthorized);
   410	    assert(!favorable.schedulerWork);
   411	    assert(!favorable.declaresCampaignSuccess);
   412	
   413	    assert(favorable.identity.canonicalText ==
   414	        kExpectedGoldenProposalCanonical);
   415	    assert(favorable.identity.hash == kExpectedGoldenProposalHash);
   416	    assert(favorable.identity.hash ==
   417	        RecommendationCanonicalHash(favorable.identity.canonicalText));
   418	
   419	    const ValidationView aligned =
   420	        MakeRecommendationCampaignFollowUpProposalValidationView(
   421	            favorableAssessment, favorableDecision);
   422	    ValidateRecommendationCampaignFollowUpProposalInput(aligned);
   423	
   424	    // Campaign mismatch is distinguished before the enclosing assessment
   425	    // canonical mismatch.
   426	    const CampaignIdentity otherCampaign = Campaign(2, "other-campaign");
   427	    const MaterializationIdentity otherCampaignMaterialization =
   428	        Materialization(otherCampaign, 1);
   429	    const Assessment otherCampaignAssessment = AssessWith(otherCampaign,
   430	        otherCampaignMaterialization, {FavorableMember(1)});
   431	    AssertRefused(favorableAssessment, Decide(otherCampaignAssessment),
   432	        "campaign_identity_mismatch");
   433	
   434	    const CampaignIdentity sameCampaign = Campaign();
   435	    const MaterializationIdentity otherMaterialization =
   436	        Materialization(sameCampaign, 1, 3, "other-materialization");
   437	    const Assessment otherMaterializationAssessment = AssessWith(sameCampaign,
   438	        otherMaterialization, {FavorableMember(1)});
   439	    AssertRefused(favorableAssessment, Decide(otherMaterializationAssessment),
   440	        "materialization_identity_mismatch");
   441	
   442	    const MaterializationIdentity sharedTwoMemberMaterialization =
   443	        Materialization(sameCampaign, 2);
   444	    const Assessment membersA = AssessWith(sameCampaign,
   445	        sharedTwoMemberMaterialization,
   446	        {FavorableMember(1), FavorableMember(2)});
   447	    const Assessment membersB = AssessWith(sameCampaign,
   448	        sharedTwoMemberMaterialization,
   449	        {Succeeded(1, SourceMetrics(), ResultMetrics(2.0, 2.0),
   450	             ComparisonContext(), ComparisonContext(), 100),
   451	            FavorableMember(2)});
   452	    AssertRefused(membersA, Decide(membersB),
   453	        "member_identity_mismatch");
   454	
   455	    const Assessment changedCanonicalAssessment = Assess(
   456	        {FavorableMember(1, false, 3.0)});
   457	    AssertRefused(changedCanonicalAssessment, favorableDecision,
   458	        "assessment_identity_mismatch");
   459	
   460	    ValidationView malformed = aligned;
   461	    malformed.assessmentIdentityHash = "fnv1a64:0000000000000000";
   462	    AssertExceptionReason([&]
   463	    {
   464	        ValidateRecommendationCampaignFollowUpProposalInput(malformed);
   465	    }, "assessment_identity_mismatch");
   466	    malformed = aligned;
   467	    malformed.decisionAssessmentIdentityHash =
   468	        "fnv1a64:0000000000000000";
   469	    AssertExceptionReason([&]
   470	    {
   471	        ValidateRecommendationCampaignFollowUpProposalInput(malformed);
   472	    }, "assessment_identity_mismatch");
   473	
   474	    malformed = aligned;
   475	    malformed.policyCanonicalText += "x";
   476	    AssertExceptionReason([&]
   477	    {
   478	        ValidateRecommendationCampaignFollowUpProposalInput(malformed);
   479	    }, "policy_identity_mismatch");
   480	    malformed = aligned;
   481	    malformed.policyIdentityHash = "fnv1a64:0000000000000000";
   482	    AssertExceptionReason([&]
   483	    {
   484	        ValidateRecommendationCampaignFollowUpProposalInput(malformed);
   485	    }, "policy_identity_mismatch");
   486	
   487	    malformed = aligned;
   488	    malformed.policyDecisionCanonicalText += "x";
   489	    AssertExceptionReason([&]
   490	    {
   491	        ValidateRecommendationCampaignFollowUpProposalInput(malformed);
   492	    }, "policy_decision_identity_mismatch");
   493	    malformed = aligned;
   494	    malformed.policyDecisionIdentityHash =
   495	        "fnv1a64:0000000000000000";
   496	    AssertExceptionReason([&]
   497	    {
   498	        ValidateRecommendationCampaignFollowUpProposalInput(malformed);
   499	    }, "policy_decision_identity_mismatch");
   500	
   501	    // Exact non-favorable Step 5C decisions fail only on copied Step 5C
   502	    // classifications; Phase 6A does not reopen its truth tables.
   503	    const Assessment neutralAssessment = Assess({Succeeded(1,
   504	        SourceMetrics(), ResultMetrics(1.0, 2.0))});
   505	    AssertRefused(neutralAssessment, Decide(neutralAssessment),
   506	        "decision_not_eligible_for_operator_review");
   507	    const Assessment unfavorableAssessment = Assess({Succeeded(1,
   508	        SourceMetrics(), ResultMetrics(0.0, 1.0))});
   509	    AssertRefused(unfavorableAssessment, Decide(unfavorableAssessment),
   510	        "decision_not_eligible_for_operator_review");
   511	    const Assessment mixedAssessment = Assess({Succeeded(1,
   512	        SourceMetrics(), ResultMetrics(2.0, 1.0))});
   513	    AssertRefused(mixedAssessment, Decide(mixedAssessment),
   514	        "decision_not_eligible_for_operator_review");
   515	    const Assessment inconclusiveAssessment = Assess({Succeeded(1,
   516	        SourceMetrics(), ResultMetrics(2.0, 2.0), ComparisonContext(),
   517	        ComparisonContext("t"))});
   518	    AssertRefused(inconclusiveAssessment, Decide(inconclusiveAssessment),
   519	        "decision_not_eligible_for_operator_review");
   520	    const Decision insufficientDecision = Decide(
   521	        favorableAssessment, PolicyWithMinimum(2));
   522	    assert(insufficientDecision.summary.evidenceSufficiency ==
   523	        EvidenceSufficiency::Insufficient);
   524	    AssertRefused(favorableAssessment, insufficientDecision,
   525	        "decision_not_eligible_for_operator_review");
   526	
   527	    malformed = aligned;
   528	    malformed.followUpAuthorized = true;
   529	    AssertExceptionReason([&]
   530	    {
   531	        ValidateRecommendationCampaignFollowUpProposalInput(malformed);
   532	    }, "follow_up_authorization_must_be_false");
   533	    malformed = aligned;
   534	    malformed.followUpEligibility = FollowUpEligibility::NotEligible;
   535	    AssertExceptionReason([&]
   536	    {
   537	        ValidateRecommendationCampaignFollowUpProposalInput(malformed);
   538	    }, "decision_not_eligible_for_operator_review");
   539	    malformed = aligned;
   540	    malformed.campaignInterpretation = CampaignInterpretation::Neutral;
   541	    AssertExceptionReason([&]
   542	    {
   543	        ValidateRecommendationCampaignFollowUpProposalInput(malformed);
   544	    }, "favorable_campaign_interpretation_required");
   545	
   546	    // A lower-is-favorable policy proves that Phase 6A trusts the exact Step
   547	    // 5C eligibility result instead of re-deriving direction or metric truth.
   548	    const Assessment decreasingAssessment = Assess({Succeeded(1,
   549	        SourceMetrics(2.0, 3.0), ResultMetrics(1.0, 2.0))});
   550	    const Decision decreasingDecision = Decide(
   551	        decreasingAssessment, LowerIsFavorablePolicy());
   552	    assert(decreasingDecision.summary.campaignInterpretation ==
   553	        CampaignInterpretation::Favorable);
   554	    assert(decreasingDecision.summary.followUpEligibility ==
   555	        FollowUpEligibility::EligibleForOperatorReview);
   556	    const Proposal decreasing = Propose(
   557	        decreasingAssessment, decreasingDecision);
   558	    assert(decreasing.summary.followUpEligibility ==
   559	        decreasingDecision.summary.followUpEligibility);
   560	
   561	    // Step 5A canonical order is the only member/metric order consumed here.
   562	    const Assessment orderedAssessment = Assess(
   563	        {FavorableMember(1), FavorableMember(2)});
   564	    const Assessment shuffledAssessment = Assess(
   565	        {FavorableMember(2, true), FavorableMember(1, true)});
   566	    const Decision orderedDecision = Decide(orderedAssessment);
   567	    const Decision shuffledDecision = Decide(shuffledAssessment);
   568	    assert(orderedAssessment.identity == shuffledAssessment.identity);
   569	    assert(orderedDecision.identity == shuffledDecision.identity);
   570	    assert(Propose(orderedAssessment, orderedDecision).identity ==
   571	        Propose(shuffledAssessment, shuffledDecision).identity);
   572	
   573	    const Assessment laterAssessment = Assess({FavorableMember(1)},
   574	        "2026-07-20 00:05:00+00");
   575	    const Decision laterDecision = Decide(laterAssessment);
   576	    assert(favorableAssessment.observedAt != laterAssessment.observedAt);
   577	    assert(favorableAssessment.identity == laterAssessment.identity);
   578	    assert(favorableDecision.identity == laterDecision.identity);
   579	    assert(favorable.identity ==
   580	        Propose(laterAssessment, laterDecision).identity);
   581	
   582	    const std::locale originalLocale = std::locale();
   583	    std::locale::global(std::locale(originalLocale, new CommaNumpunct));
   584	    const Assessment localizedAssessment = Assess({FavorableMember(1)});
   585	    const Decision localizedDecision = Decide(localizedAssessment);
   586	    const Proposal localized = Propose(
   587	        localizedAssessment, localizedDecision);
   588	    std::locale::global(originalLocale);
   589	    assert(localized.identity == favorable.identity);
   590	
   591	    const Proposal changedEvidence = Propose(changedCanonicalAssessment,
   592	        Decide(changedCanonicalAssessment));
   593	    assert(changedEvidence.assessmentIdentityHash !=
   594	        favorable.assessmentIdentityHash);
   595	    assert(changedEvidence.identity.hash != favorable.identity.hash);
   596	    assert(changedEvidence.policyDecisionIdentityHash !=
   597	        favorable.policyDecisionIdentityHash);
   598	
   599	    const Assessment twoMemberAssessment = Assess(
   600	        {FavorableMember(1), FavorableMember(2)});
   601	    const Decision minimumOneDecision = Decide(
   602	        twoMemberAssessment, PolicyWithMinimum(1));
   603	    const Decision minimumTwoDecision = Decide(
   604	        twoMemberAssessment, PolicyWithMinimum(2));
   605	    const Proposal minimumOne = Propose(
   606	        twoMemberAssessment, minimumOneDecision);
   607	    const Proposal minimumTwo = Propose(
   608	        twoMemberAssessment, minimumTwoDecision);
   609	    assert(minimumOne.policyIdentityHash != minimumTwo.policyIdentityHash);
   610	    assert(minimumOne.policyDecisionIdentityHash !=
   611	        minimumTwo.policyDecisionIdentityHash);
   612	    assert(minimumOne.identity.hash != minimumTwo.identity.hash);
   613	
   614	    // IEEE negative zero is normalized upstream, while non-finite evidence is
   615	    // rejected upstream before Phase 6A can inherit a malformed identity.
   616	    const Assessment negativeZeroAssessment = Assess({Succeeded(1,
   617	        SourceMetrics(-0.0, 2.0), ResultMetrics(0.0, 3.0))});
   618	    const Assessment positiveZeroAssessment = Assess({Succeeded(1,
   619	        SourceMetrics(0.0, 2.0), ResultMetrics(0.0, 3.0))});
   620	    assert(negativeZeroAssessment.identity == positiveZeroAssessment.identity);
   621	    assert(Propose(negativeZeroAssessment, Decide(negativeZeroAssessment))
   622	            .identity ==
   623	        Propose(positiveZeroAssessment, Decide(positiveZeroAssessment))
   624	            .identity);
   625	    AssertExceptionReason([]
   626	    {
   627	        (void)Assess({Succeeded(1, SourceMetrics(),
   628	            ResultMetrics(std::numeric_limits<double>::infinity(), 3.0))});
   629	    }, "recommendation_campaign_outcome_assessment_metric_value_nonfinite");
   630	
   631	    ValidateRecommendationCampaignFollowUpProposalCanonicalSize(
   632	        kMaximumRecommendationCampaignFollowUpProposalCanonicalTextBytes);
   633	    AssertExceptionReason([]
   634	    {
   635	        ValidateRecommendationCampaignFollowUpProposalCanonicalSize(
   636	            kMaximumRecommendationCampaignFollowUpProposalCanonicalTextBytes +
   637	            1U);
   638	    }, "proposal_canonical_size_exceeded");
   639	
   640	    const CampaignIdentity largeCampaign = Campaign(
   641	        9, std::string(400000, 'x'));
   642	    const MaterializationIdentity largeMaterialization =
   643	        Materialization(largeCampaign, 1, 10, "large-materialization");
   644	    const Assessment largeAssessment = AssessWith(largeCampaign,
   645	        largeMaterialization, {FavorableMember(1)});
   646	    const Decision largeDecision = Decide(largeAssessment);
   647	    assert(largeDecision.summary.followUpEligibility ==
   648	        FollowUpEligibility::EligibleForOperatorReview);
   649	    AssertRefused(largeAssessment, largeDecision,
   650	        "proposal_canonical_size_exceeded");
   651	
   652	    malformed = aligned;
   653	    malformed.assessmentContractVersion = 3;
   654	    AssertExceptionReason([&]
   655	    {
   656	        ValidateRecommendationCampaignFollowUpProposalInput(malformed);
   657	    }, "assessment_contract_unsupported");
   658	    malformed = aligned;
   659	    malformed.policyContractVersion = 2;
   660	    AssertExceptionReason([&]
   661	    {
   662	        ValidateRecommendationCampaignFollowUpProposalInput(malformed);
   663	    }, "policy_contract_unsupported");
   664	    malformed = aligned;
   665	    malformed.policyDecisionContractVersion = 2;
   666	    AssertExceptionReason([&]
   667	    {
   668	        ValidateRecommendationCampaignFollowUpProposalInput(malformed);
   669	    }, "policy_decision_contract_unsupported");
   670	
   671	    assert(RecommendationCampaignFollowUpProposalReasonText(
   672	        ProposalReason::EligibleFavorablePolicyDecision) ==
   673	        "eligible_favorable_policy_decision");
   674	
   675	    return 0;
   676	}

   820	      contextChangedMetricCount(contextChangedMetricCountValue),
   821	      missingSourceMetricCount(missingSourceMetricCountValue),
   822	      missingResultMetricCount(missingResultMetricCountValue),
   823	      metricValueUnavailableCount(metricValueUnavailableCountValue),
   824	      unsupportedMetricCount(unsupportedMetricCountValue),
   825	      positiveDeltaCount(positiveDeltaCountValue),
   826	      zeroDeltaCount(zeroDeltaCountValue),
   827	      negativeDeltaCount(negativeDeltaCountValue)
   828	{
   829	    const int lifecycleTotal = notTerminalLifecycleCount +
   830	        succeededLifecycleCount + failedLifecycleCount +
   831	        cancelledLifecycleCount + unknownLifecycleCount;
   832	    const int consistencyTotal =
   833	        consistentMemberCount + inconsistentMemberCount;
   834	    const int outcomeTotal = notReadyMemberCount +
   835	        succeededComparableMemberCount + succeededContextChangedMemberCount +
   836	        succeededMetricGapMemberCount + terminalFailedMemberCount +
   837	        terminalCancelledMemberCount + inconsistentOutcomeMemberCount;
   838	    const std::size_t comparisonTotal = comparableMetricCount +
   839	        contextChangedMetricCount + missingSourceMetricCount +
   840	        missingResultMetricCount + metricValueUnavailableCount +
   841	        unsupportedMetricCount;
   842	    const std::size_t deltaTotal =
   843	        positiveDeltaCount + zeroDeltaCount + negativeDeltaCount;
   844	    if (memberCount <= 0 || lifecycleTotal != memberCount ||
   845	        consistencyTotal != memberCount || outcomeTotal != memberCount ||
   846	        comparisonTotal != metricComparisonCount ||
   847	        deltaTotal != comparableMetricCount)
   848	        throw std::logic_error(
   849	            "recommendation_campaign_outcome_assessment_summary_invariant_failed");
   850	}

   852	RecommendationCampaignOutcomeAssessmentMember::

   854	        RecommendationCampaignOutcomeAssessmentMemberIdentity identityValue,
   855	        Lifecycle lifecycleValue,
   856	        Consistency consistencyValue,
   857	        MemberOutcome outcomeValue,
   858	        std::vector<Diagnostic> diagnosticsValue,
   859	        std::optional<
   860	            RecommendationCampaignOutcomeAssessmentSourceEvidence>
   861	            sourceEvidenceValue,
   862	        std::optional<
   863	            RecommendationCampaignOutcomeAssessmentResultEvidence>
   864	            resultEvidenceValue,
   865	        std::vector<Comparison> comparisonsValue)
   866	    : identity(std::move(identityValue)),
   867	      lifecycle(lifecycleValue),
   868	      consistency(consistencyValue),
   869	      outcome(outcomeValue),
   870	      diagnostics(std::move(diagnosticsValue)),
   871	      sourceEvidence(std::move(sourceEvidenceValue)),
   872	      resultEvidence(std::move(resultEvidenceValue)),
   873	      comparisons(std::move(comparisonsValue))
   874	{
   875	    const bool inconsistent = consistency == Consistency::Inconsistent;
   876	    if (inconsistent != !diagnostics.empty() ||
   877	        inconsistent != (outcome == MemberOutcome::Inconsistent) ||
   878	        (inconsistent && !comparisons.empty()))
   879	        throw std::logic_error(
   880	            "recommendation_campaign_outcome_assessment_member_invariant_failed");
   881	}

   883	RecommendationCampaignOutcomeAssessmentIdentity::
   884	    RecommendationCampaignOutcomeAssessmentIdentity(
   885	        int contractVersionValue,
   886	        std::string canonicalTextValue,
   887	        std::string hashValue)
   888	    : contractVersion(contractVersionValue),
   889	      canonicalText(std::move(canonicalTextValue)),
   890	      hash(std::move(hashValue))
   891	{

   894	        hash != RecommendationCanonicalHash(canonicalText))
   895	        throw std::logic_error(

   898	        "recommendation_campaign_outcome_assessment_identity_missing");

   904	        RecommendationCampaignOutcomeAssessmentCampaignIdentity
   905	            campaignIdentityValue,

   924	
   925	struct RecommendationCampaignOutcomeAssessmentBuilder
   926	{
   927	    static std::vector<Comparison> BuildComparisons(
   928	        const MemberEvidence& evidence,
   929	        bool& nonFiniteDelta)
   930	    {
   931	        const auto* sourceMetrics = evidence.sourceEvidence
   932	            ? &evidence.sourceEvidence->metrics.metrics
   933	            : nullptr;
   934	        const auto& resultMetrics = evidence.resultEvidence->metrics.metrics;
   935	        std::vector<Difference> differences;
   936	        if (evidence.sourceEvidence)
   937	            differences = ContextDifferences(
   938	                evidence.sourceEvidence->context,
   939	                *evidence.resultEvidence->context);
   940	
   941	        std::vector<Comparison> comparisons;
   942	        std::size_t sourceIndex = 0;
   943	        std::size_t resultIndex = 0;
   944	        while ((sourceMetrics && sourceIndex < sourceMetrics->size()) ||
   945	            resultIndex < resultMetrics.size())
   946	        {
   947	            const Metric* source = sourceMetrics &&
   948	                    sourceIndex < sourceMetrics->size()
   949	                ? &(*sourceMetrics)[sourceIndex]
   950	                : nullptr;
   951	            const Metric* result = resultIndex < resultMetrics.size()
   952	                ? &resultMetrics[resultIndex]
   953	                : nullptr;
   954	            if (source && result && source->identity == result->identity)
   955	            {
   956	                if (!differences.empty())
   957	                    comparisons.push_back(Comparison(source->identity,
   958	                        Classification::ContextChanged, source->value,
   959	                        result->value, std::nullopt, differences));
   960	                else if (!source->value || !result->value)
   961	                    comparisons.push_back(Comparison(source->identity,
   962	                        Classification::MetricValueUnavailable, source->value,
   963	                        result->value, std::nullopt, {}));
   964	                else if (source->comparisonSupport != MetricSupport::NumericDelta ||
   965	                    result->comparisonSupport != MetricSupport::NumericDelta)
   966	                    comparisons.push_back(Comparison(source->identity,
   967	                        Classification::Unsupported, source->value,
   968	                        result->value, std::nullopt, {}));
   969	                else
   970	                {
   971	                    double delta = *result->value - *source->value;
   972	                    if (!std::isfinite(delta))
   973	                    {
   974	                        nonFiniteDelta = true;
   975	                        return {};
   976	                    }
   977	                    if (delta == 0.0) delta = 0.0;
   978	                    comparisons.push_back(Comparison(source->identity,
   979	                        Classification::Comparable, source->value,
   980	                        result->value, delta, {}));
   981	                }
   982	                ++sourceIndex;
   983	                ++resultIndex;
   984	            }
   985	            else if (source &&
   986	                (!result || source->identity < result->identity))
   987	            {
   988	                comparisons.push_back(Comparison(source->identity,
   989	                    Classification::MissingResultMetric, source->value,
   990	                    std::nullopt, std::nullopt, {}));
   991	                ++sourceIndex;
   992	            }
   993	            else
   994	            {
   995	                comparisons.push_back(Comparison(result->identity,
   996	                    Classification::MissingSourceMetric, std::nullopt,
   997	                    result->value, std::nullopt, {}));
   998	                ++resultIndex;
   999	            }
  1000	        }
  1001	        return comparisons;
  1002	    }
  1003	
  1004	    static MemberOutcome DeriveMemberOutcome(
  1005	        Lifecycle lifecycle,
  1006	        const std::vector<Diagnostic>& diagnostics,
  1007	        const std::vector<Comparison>& comparisons)
  1008	    {
  1009	        if (!diagnostics.empty()) return MemberOutcome::Inconsistent;
  1010	        switch (lifecycle)
  1011	        {
  1012	            case Lifecycle::NotTerminal:
  1013	            case Lifecycle::Unknown:
  1014	                return MemberOutcome::NotReady;
  1015	            case Lifecycle::Failed:
  1016	                return MemberOutcome::TerminalFailed;
  1017	            case Lifecycle::Cancelled:
  1018	                return MemberOutcome::TerminalCancelled;
  1019	            case Lifecycle::Succeeded:
  1020	                break;
  1021	        }
  1022	        if (std::any_of(comparisons.begin(), comparisons.end(),
  1023	                [](const Comparison& comparison)
  1024	        {
  1025	            return comparison.classification == Classification::ContextChanged;
  1026	        }))
  1027	            return MemberOutcome::SucceededContextChanged;
  1028	        if (comparisons.empty() ||
  1029	            std::any_of(comparisons.begin(), comparisons.end(),
  1030	                [](const Comparison& comparison)
  1031	        {
  1032	            return comparison.classification != Classification::Comparable;
  1033	        }))
  1034	            return MemberOutcome::SucceededMetricGap;
  1035	        return MemberOutcome::SucceededComparable;
  1036	    }
  1037	
  1038	    static RecommendationCampaignOutcomeAssessment Build(
  1039	        const RecommendationCampaignOutcomeAssessmentCampaignIdentity&
  1040	            campaignIdentity,
  1041	        const RecommendationCampaignOutcomeAssessmentMaterializationIdentity&
  1042	            materializationIdentity,
  1043	        const std::string& observedAt,
  1044	        const std::vector<MemberEvidence>& members)
  1045	    {
  1046	        RequireText(observedAt,
  1047	            "recommendation_campaign_outcome_assessment_observed_at_invalid");
  1048	        if (materializationIdentity.campaignApprovalId !=
  1049	                campaignIdentity.campaignApprovalId ||
  1050	            materializationIdentity.campaignIdentityHash !=
  1200	            if (indices.size() < 2) continue;
  1201	            for (const auto index : indices)
  1202	                working[index].diagnostics.push_back(
  1203	                    Diagnostic::ResultIdentityReused);
  1204	        }
  1205	
  1206	        std::vector<Member> assessedMembers;
  1207	        assessedMembers.reserve(working.size());
  1208	        for (auto& item : working)
  1209	        {
  1210	            CanonicalizeDiagnostics(item.diagnostics);
  1211	            std::vector<Comparison> comparisons;
  1212	            if (item.diagnostics.empty() &&
  1213	                item.evidence->lifecycle == Lifecycle::Succeeded)
  1214	            {
  1215	                bool nonFiniteDelta = false;
  1216	                comparisons = BuildComparisons(*item.evidence, nonFiniteDelta);
  1217	                if (nonFiniteDelta)
  1218	                {
  1219	                    item.diagnostics.push_back(
  1220	                        Diagnostic::NumericDeltaNonFinite);
  1221	                    comparisons.clear();
  1222	                }
  1223	            }
  1224	            CanonicalizeDiagnostics(item.diagnostics);
  1225	            const Consistency consistency = item.diagnostics.empty()
  1226	                ? Consistency::Consistent
  1227	                : Consistency::Inconsistent;
  1228	            const MemberOutcome outcome = DeriveMemberOutcome(
  1229	                item.evidence->lifecycle, item.diagnostics, comparisons);
  1230	            assessedMembers.push_back(Member(item.evidence->identity,
  1231	                item.evidence->lifecycle, consistency, outcome,
  1232	                item.diagnostics, item.evidence->sourceEvidence,
  1233	                item.evidence->resultEvidence, std::move(comparisons)));
  1234	        }
  1235	
  1236	        MutableSummary counts;
  1237	        for (const auto& member : assessedMembers) CountMember(counts, member);
  1238	        const AggregateOutcome aggregateOutcome =
  1239	            DeriveAggregateOutcome(counts);
  1240	        RecommendationCampaignOutcomeAssessmentSummary summary(
  1241	            aggregateOutcome, counts.memberCount,
  1242	            counts.notTerminalLifecycleCount, counts.succeededLifecycleCount,
  1243	            counts.failedLifecycleCount, counts.cancelledLifecycleCount,
  1244	            counts.unknownLifecycleCount, counts.consistentMemberCount,
  1245	            counts.inconsistentMemberCount, counts.notReadyMemberCount,
  1246	            counts.succeededComparableMemberCount,
  1247	            counts.succeededContextChangedMemberCount,
  1248	            counts.succeededMetricGapMemberCount,
  1249	            counts.terminalFailedMemberCount,
  1250	            counts.terminalCancelledMemberCount,
  1251	            counts.inconsistentOutcomeMemberCount,
  1252	            counts.metricComparisonCount, counts.comparableMetricCount,
  1253	            counts.contextChangedMetricCount,
  1254	            counts.missingSourceMetricCount,
  1255	            counts.missingResultMetricCount,
  1256	            counts.metricValueUnavailableCount,
  1257	            counts.unsupportedMetricCount, counts.positiveDeltaCount,
  1258	            counts.zeroDeltaCount, counts.negativeDeltaCount);
  1259	        std::string canonical = AssessmentCanonicalText(campaignIdentity,
  1260	            materializationIdentity, summary, assessedMembers);
  1261	        RecommendationCampaignOutcomeAssessmentIdentity identity(
  1262	            kRecommendationCampaignOutcomeAssessmentContractVersion,
  1263	            canonical, RecommendationCanonicalHash(canonical));
  1264	        return RecommendationCampaignOutcomeAssessment(std::move(identity),
  1265	            campaignIdentity, materializationIdentity, observedAt,
  1266	            std::move(summary), std::move(assessedMembers));
  1267	    }
  1268	};

     1	Phase 6A Recommendation Campaign Follow-Up Proposal
     2	====================================================
     3	
     4	Purpose and entity
     5	------------------
     6	
     7	Phase 6A defines ``RecommendationCampaignFollowUpProposal``: one pure,
     8	immutable, deterministic advisory candidate for later operator review.  The
     9	name deliberately distinguishes this value from Phase 4D campaign
    10	materialization, which is an explicit persisted operation over an approved
    11	campaign.  A Phase 6A proposal materializes nothing.
    12	
    13	Exact immutable inputs
    14	----------------------
    15	
    16	The builder accepts exactly one Phase 5A
    17	``RecommendationCampaignOutcomeAssessment`` contract version 2 and one Phase
    18	5C ``RecommendationCampaignOutcomePolicyDecision`` contract version 1.  The
    19	decision must embed a Phase 5C policy contract version 1.  Phase 6A consumes
    20	only their public immutable typed values; it does not consume Step 5B formatted
    21	output, a database row, repository metadata, a scheduler value, a CLI request,
    22	or mutable operator state.
    23	
    24	Eligibility prerequisite
    25	------------------------
    26	
    27	Construction requires the validated Step 5C decision to report all of:
    28	
    29	* ``followUpEligibility == EligibleForOperatorReview``;
    30	* ``followUpAuthorized == false``; and
    31	* ``campaignInterpretation == Favorable``.
    32	
    33	Phase 6A does not derive those values, inspect Step 5A metric truth tables, or
    34	recalculate Step 5C evidence sufficiency, direction, interpretation, or
    35	eligibility.  It copies the exact decision classifications after validation.
    36	Eligibility for operator review remains neither approval nor authorization.
    37	
    38	Alignment and fail-closed validation
    39	------------------------------------
    40	
    41	Before construction, the builder validates supported assessment, policy, and
    42	policy-decision versions and each authoritative-canonical/tagged-hash pair.
    43	The decision's embedded assessment version, canonical text, and hash must
    44	equal the supplied assessment exactly.  Hash equality is never substituted
    45	for canonical-text equality.
    46	
    47	Campaign approval ID, campaign canonical identity and hash, complete
    48	materialization identity and approval linkage, member counts, and every
    49	ordered member identity must match exactly.  Member identity includes ordinal,
    50	materialization-member ID, ranking-member ID, recommendation ID, source-
    51	experiment ID, proposal ID, and optional expected-experiment ID.  Mismatch,
    52	malformed identity, unsupported version, non-eligibility, non-favorable
    53	interpretation, or authorization fails closed with a stable explicit reason.
    54	The narrow plain-data validation view exists only for safe malformed-boundary
    55	tests and cannot construct any upstream value, proposal identity, or proposal.
    56	Stable boundary reasons include ``assessment_contract_unsupported``,
    57	``policy_contract_unsupported``, ``policy_decision_contract_unsupported``,
    58	``assessment_identity_mismatch``, ``policy_identity_mismatch``,
    59	``policy_decision_identity_mismatch``, ``campaign_identity_mismatch``,
    60	``materialization_identity_mismatch``, ``member_count_mismatch``,
    61	``member_identity_mismatch``, ``decision_not_eligible_for_operator_review``,
    62	``favorable_campaign_interpretation_required``, and
    63	``follow_up_authorization_must_be_false``.
    64	
    65	Immutable output and non-authority
    66	----------------------------------
    67	
    68	The output exposes the proposal contract version; exact assessment, policy,
    69	and policy-decision version/canonical/hash triples; complete campaign and
    70	materialization identities; exact ordered members and count; copied Step 5C
    71	evidence sufficiency, campaign interpretation, eligibility, and false
    72	authorization; and the stable provenance reason
    73	``eligible_favorable_policy_decision``.
    74	
    75	The type fixes these semantics at compile time and in canonical identity:
    76	``readOnly=true``, ``databaseFree=true``, ``persistent=false``,
    77	``advisory=true``, ``authoritative=false``, ``approved=false``,
    78	``activated=false``, ``executionAuthorized=false``,
    79	``followUpAuthorized=false``, ``schedulerWork=false``, and
    80	``declaresCampaignSuccess=false``.
    81	
    82	Canonical identity grammar
    83	--------------------------
    84	
    85	Contract version 1 canonical text begins with
    86	``experiment_recommendation_campaign_follow_up_proposal_v1``.  Semicolon-
    87	named fields bind, in order:
    88	
    89	* proposal version and every fixed safety semantic;
    90	* assessment, policy, and policy-decision version/canonical/hash triples;
    91	* campaign approval ID/canonical/hash;
    92	* materialization ID, approval linkage, contract version, member count,
    93	  canonical text, and hash;
    94	* each upstream-canonical ordered member identity, including
    95	  ``expected_experiment_id``;
    96	* Step 5C evidence sufficiency, campaign interpretation, follow-up
    97	  eligibility, false decision authorization, and proposal reason.
    98	
    99	Every embedded canonical string and other delimiter-capable text is framed as
   100	``BYTE_LENGTH:VALUE``.  Integer and length formatting uses the classic locale.
   101	Canonical text is authoritative; the existing tagged FNV-1a hash is only an
   102	accelerator.  ``observedAt``, clocks, PID, CLI formatting, repository metadata,
   103	and any future approval or activation state are excluded.  Consequently,
   104	observation time cannot change identity, while every behaviorally relevant
   105	upstream identity can.
   106	
   107	Canonical-size limit
   108	--------------------
   109	
   110	Version 1 permits at most 1,048,576 canonical-text bytes.  The builder checks
   111	the completed canonical byte count before identity and proposal construction
   112	and throws ``proposal_canonical_size_exceeded`` above that inclusive ceiling.
   113	The bound limits a future review/persistence payload deliberately; it neither
   114	adds persistence nor predicts a later database schema.  Any later change to
   115	the ceiling or grammar requires a new contract version or an explicitly
   116	compatible architecture decision.
   117	
   118	Non-goals and later Phase 6 boundaries
   119	--------------------------------------
   120	
   121	Phase 6A adds no SQL, migration, table, repository, service, formatter, CLI,
   122	preview command, operator-review persistence, approval, rejection, activation,
   123	execution, scheduler work, queue, worker, campaign, recommendation, experiment,
   124	or Phase 4D materialization.  It does not claim profitability, statistical
   125	significance, repeatability, campaign success, or follow-up authorization.
   126	
   127	Persistence, explicit operator review, approval/rejection, activation, and
   128	execution remain distinct possible Phase 6B--6F concerns.  This contract does
   129	not authorize, prescribe, or partially implement any of them.
     1	# ADR-0006: Phase 6A follow-up proposal is advisory and identity-bound
     2	
     3	Status: Accepted
     4	Date: 2026-07-20
     5	Deciders: Project architecture
     6	Affected volumes: Volume VIII §§2–5, 9, 11
     7	Supersedes: None
     8	Superseded by: None
     9	
    10	## 1. Context and problem statement
    11	
    12	Phase 5A produces one immutable campaign outcome assessment, and Phase 5C
    13	produces one immutable advisory policy decision that may mark the exact
    14	assessment eligible for later operator review. That eligibility is not itself
    15	an approval, authorization, persisted review, experiment, or scheduler work
    16	item. The first Phase 6 increment needs a deterministic candidate that preserves
    17	the exact upstream identity without colliding conceptually with Phase 4D
    18	campaign materialization or silently reopening the scientific decision.
    19	
    20	## 2. Decision
    21	
    22	Phase 6A introduces the distinct pure domain entity
    23	`RecommendationCampaignFollowUpProposal` with contract version 1.
    24	
    25	- It binds exactly one Phase 5A assessment v2 and one Phase 5C policy decision
    26	  v1 containing one policy v1.
    27	- Construction requires exact canonical-text, hash, campaign,
    28	  materialization, ordered-member, count, and embedded-assessment alignment.
    29	- Construction requires the Step 5C result to be eligible for operator review,
    30	  favorable, and explicitly non-authorizing. Phase 6A does not recalculate
    31	  eligibility.
    32	- Canonical text is authoritative identity. The tagged hash is only an
    33	  accelerator, and canonical text is compared even when hashes match.
    34	- Embedded canonical and delimiter-capable strings are byte-length framed.
    35	- Canonical text is independent of observation time and bounded to 1,048,576
    36	  bytes before immutable construction.
    37	- The proposal is read-only, database-free, non-persistent, advisory,
    38	  non-authoritative, unapproved, inactive, non-executing, non-authorizing,
    39	  non-scheduler work, and does not declare campaign success.
    40	- Phase 6A adds no repository, SQL, migration, service, CLI, formatter,
    41	  persisted operator review, scheduler consumer, queue, worker, or lifecycle
    42	  mutation.
    43	- Persistence, review, activation, and execution remain separate possible
    44	  later Phase 6 steps and receive no authority from this ADR.
    45	
    46	## 3. Rationale and decision drivers
    47	
    48	- Preserve exact upstream scientific and policy provenance without copying or
    49	  reinterpreting their truth tables.
    50	- Keep operator-review eligibility visibly separate from approval and action.
    51	- Make collision handling safe by retaining authoritative canonical text.
    52	- Avoid the misleading implication that an advisory proposal is Phase 4D
    53	  materialization or any experiment lifecycle request.
    54	- Keep later persistence and operational designs free to establish their own
    55	  authorities, transactions, idempotency, and concurrency contracts.
    56	
    57	## 4. Consequences
    58	
    59	### 4.1 Positive consequences
    60	
    61	- Identical validated Phase 5 inputs yield an identical Phase 6A identity
    62	  regardless of locale or observation time.
    63	- Every relevant upstream identity and explicit non-authority semantic is
    64	  reviewable in one immutable candidate.
    65	- Unsupported, mismatched, non-favorable, noneligible, authorizing, or
    66	  oversized inputs fail closed with stable reasons.
    67	- No database, scheduler, or execution dependency enters the pure boundary.
    68	
    69	### 4.2 Negative consequences and trade-offs
    70	
    71	- Binding complete upstream canonical text duplicates data and can produce a
    72	  sizable canonical value.
    73	- The 1 MiB ceiling may reject exceptionally large but otherwise valid Phase 5
    74	  decisions; changing that ceiling requires explicit versioned design.
    75	- Phase 6A alone cannot record or enact an operator decision.
    76	
    77	### 4.3 Risks and mitigations
    78	
    79	- Hash collision: compare authoritative canonical text after any hash match.
    80	- Upstream identity drift: validate exact version/canonical/hash and direct
    81	  campaign, materialization, and ordered-member fields.
    82	- Accidental authority creep: compile-time false safety flags, canonical
    83	  bindings, pure tests, and absence of persistence/scheduler integration.
    84	- Oversized future payload: reject above the fixed byte ceiling before
    85	  proposal construction.
    86	
    87	## 5. Compatibility and migration
    88	
    89	The change is additive C++ domain code and documentation. It requires no
    90	schema, data, privilege, repository, CLI, runtime, or scheduler migration and
    91	does not modify Phase 5A, 5B, or 5C contracts.
    92	
    93	## 6. Verification and operational evidence
    94	
    95	- Golden canonical text and independently fixed tagged hash.
    96	- Exact upstream alignment and stable refusal-reason tests.
    97	- Favorable/non-favorable, invariance, identity-sensitivity, IEEE edge, size,
    98	  malformed-version, and construction-access tests.
    99	- Focused normal, ASan, and UBSan runs plus Phase 4D/5 regression tests.
   100	- Both existing Xcode targets compile the source in an incremental Release
   101	  build; no Debug or clean build is required.
   102	
   103	## 7. Alternatives considered
   104	
   105	### 7.1 Generic materialization entity
   106	
   107	Rejected because it could be confused with the persisted Phase 4D operation
   108	that materializes an approved campaign into Phase 4C proposals.
   109	
   110	### 7.2 Build from Step 5B formatted output
   111	
   112	Rejected because presentation text is not the immutable typed Phase 5A/5C
   113	contract and would weaken exact identity alignment.
   114	
   115	### 7.3 Recompute Step 5C eligibility in Phase 6A
   116	
   117	Rejected because it would duplicate policy truth, risk divergence, and reopen
   118	scientific interpretation outside the versioned Step 5C owner.
   119	
   120	### 7.4 Persist or approve the proposal in Phase 6A
   121	
   122	Rejected because persistence, operator review, approval, activation, and
   123	execution require distinct later authority and operational designs.
   124
